summary: Separate fault snapshot and delivery work in reconciler profile spans.

replay.detail: No claim, message, or checkpoint replay changes. Fault snapshot selection and message delivery retain their existing order and idempotency key.

schema.detail: No table, index, trigger, migration, or persistent view changes.

rules.detail: Fault ownership, current-state checks, refusal and recovery guards, and throttle timing are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: When profiling is enabled, two fixed child spans distinguish the complete fault.snapshot read from fault.delivery owner filtering and message work. Existing stage/faults totals remain inclusive; the child phases are disjoint, and no client or wire field changes. Span wall, CPU, and SQL counters are diagnostic, not a claim of per-family SQL attribution or writer cost.

downtime.detail: No restart or migration beyond ordinary deployment is needed. The added profiling overhead and production CPU effect are unmeasured.

manual.detail: No new setup is required; existing opt-in profiling controls whether the spans are recorded.

recovery.detail: No persisted recovery state changes. Disabling profiling or reverting the spans restores the earlier accounting without changing fault messages.
